meta.label: ESTIMATED COMPOSITE — blends MEASURED white-space + competitor density with ESTIMATED province crop-stress. A ranking aid for branch expansion (objective #2), not a measured quantity. Every component is exposed per district for honesty.
meta.objective: Acquisition / where to expand — rank amphoe (districts) by expansion opportunity.
meta.id_note: id is the th_amphoe.geojson shapeID — identical key to build_amphoe.py amphoe[].id.

components_note.whitespace: 0-100 norm of amphoe.json whitespace (MEASURED demand minus AutoX saturation). higher = more underserved.
components_note.agri_stress: province crop-household stress from crop_stress.json (0..1 -> 0-100), province-inherited. ESTIMATED.
components_note.competitor_gap: 100 minus 0-100 norm of competitor count (PIP). higher = fewer competitors = more room. MEASURED, best-effort census.
components_note.occupation_pull: 0-100 norm of log1p(establishment total) from amphoe_occupations.json. MEASURED. present only if that file exists.
components_note._competitors: raw competitor branch count inside the polygon (audit field).

meta.score_formula: score = sum(weight_k * component_k) / sum(weight_k) over available terms k (0-100).
